reasoning_content:
While the build is progressing, let's also get the frontend build started. But wait — the frontend needs the `ng` CLI (part of @angular/cli, installed in node_modules). `nx serve startuphafen-frontend` uses @angular-devkit/build-angular:dev-server.

First let's check the keycloak reproduction status (it takes about 75 seconds), then start the frontend.

No, actually let's just kick off the frontend dev server in the background right now — it'll take time to build.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup npx nx serve startuphafen-frontend > /tmp/frontend_serve.log 2>&1 &
echo "frontend serve started: $!"
sleep 5
tail -3 /tmp/frontend_serve.log

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace && nohup npx nx serve startuphafen-frontend > /tmp/frontend_serve.log 2>&1 &
echo "frontend serve started: $!"
sleep 5
tail -3 /tmp/frontend_serve.log", "summary": "Start frontend dev server in background", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}

summary: Start frontend dev server in background
